results.evidence: ISHRuntimeFlags.h defines ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP 1. TerminalViewController.m startSession implements the boundary check after do_execve() and before task_start(current), returning 0 when flag is set to prevent guest execution while allowing session bootstrap.

AppDelegate.m boot() checks ISH_TASK_ZERO_DISABLE_EMULATION at method entry. When flag is 1, records ISHInstrumentationEventSessionStarted event and returns 0 immediately. No bootLogPath file operations, no /tmp write tests, no excessive NSLog probes, no ELF forensics code present.

TerminalViewController.m allows session bootstrap (become_new_init_child, PTY creation, create_stdio, do_execve) but blocks task_start when ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP is 1. Records event via ISHInstrumentation and returns 0. UI loads without guest execution, app remains alive.
